pairing.unit: one independent provider request paired with the immutable authoritative observation for the same reviewed case
pairing.baseline: byte-preserving replay of the frozen Phase 0 observation; no outcome or evidence is inferred
pairing.candidate: VerificationSpec v0 generated from the same goal, intent, and profile; fix/investigate also receive their frozen reviewed evidence registry; provider-declared execution is never trusted
exclusion_rules: abort the campaign, without excluding a row, when a result record cannot be persisted
timeouts, provider errors, malformed JSON, schema rejection, empty claims, and policy rejection remain included as candidate failures
no exclusion rule may be changed after the first candidate response is persisted

scoring.claim_match: exact registered claim ID only; no semantic similarity or LLM judge
scoring.strong_binding: candidate claim must exactly match a registered claim ID and the frozen authoritative observation must contain executed evidence at or above its registered minimum strength
scoring.candidate_verdict: the frozen authoritative verdict, because the candidate remains shadow-only and cannot alter authority
scoring.resource_measurement: Ollama prompt_eval_count, eval_count, and total_duration for the candidate request

authorization.scope: local Ollama Phase 6 paired A/B only
